choice_context: Choosing between actions based on personal values and situational factors
reasoning: Identifying the most significant underlying preference dimensions that encompass a wide range of themes while ensuring distinctiveness and bipolarity.

dimensions.name: Directness vs. Indirectness in Communication

low_pole.label: Indirect Communication
low_pole.description: Preferring to communicate in a roundabout way to avoid direct confrontation or to soften the message.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who avoids conflict and prefers to maintain harmony.

high_pole.label: Direct Communication
high_pole.description: Preferring clear and straightforward communication, even if it means addressing difficult topics head-on.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values honesty and clarity over maintaining peace at all costs.

example_contrast.low_option: Suggesting someone needs to improve their work indirectly through hints.
example_contrast.high_option: Telling someone directly they need to improve their work.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who prefer direct communication and lower for those who prefer indirect communication.

dimensions.name: Conflict Avoidance vs. Confrontation

low_pole.label: Conflict Avoidance
low_pole.description: Preferring to avoid situations that might lead to conflict or disagreement.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prioritizes peace and harmony over addressing issues directly.

high_pole.label: Confrontation
high_pole.description: Being willing to engage in conflict to address issues or stand up for oneself.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who believes in facing problems head-on rather than avoiding them.

example_contrast.low_option: Avoiding a discussion about a sensitive topic.
example_contrast.high_option: Initiating a discussion about a sensitive topic.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who prefer confrontation and lower for those who avoid conflict.

dimensions.name: Privacy and Personal Space vs. Social Bonding

low_pole.label: Privacy and Personal Space
low_pole.description: Valuing personal space and privacy over social interactions.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prefers solitude and private time.

high_pole.label: Social Bonding
high_pole.description: Valuing social interactions and relationships over personal space.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who enjoys being around others and building connections.

example_contrast.low_option: Spending time alone reading a book.
example_contrast.high_option: Going out with friends to a party.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who value social bonding and lower for those who prioritize privacy.

dimensions.name: Professional Responsibility vs. Personal Freedom

low_pole.label: Professional Responsibility
low_pole.description: Prioritizing professional duties and obligations over personal desires.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who takes their job very seriously and puts work first.

high_pole.label: Personal Freedom
high_pole.description: Prioritizing personal freedom and autonomy over professional responsibilities.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values personal time and flexibility over strict adherence to professional duties.

example_contrast.low_option: Working overtime to complete a project.
example_contrast.high_option: Taking a day off to relax and pursue personal interests.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who value personal freedom and lower for those who prioritize professional responsibility.

dimensions.name: Trust and Honesty vs. Skepticism

low_pole.label: Skepticism
low_pole.description: Being cautious and skeptical about trusting others or believing what they say.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who is wary of others and prefers to verify information independently.

high_pole.label: Trust and Honesty
high_pole.description: Being open to trusting others and valuing honesty in relationships.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who trusts easily and values transparency in interactions.

example_contrast.low_option: Checking multiple sources before believing a news report.
example_contrast.high_option: Believing a friend's story without question.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who trust easily and lower for those who are skeptical.

dimensions.name: Financial Responsibility vs. Immediate Gratification

low_pole.label: Immediate Gratification
low_pole.description: Valuing immediate pleasure or satisfaction over long-term financial stability.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who likes to spend money on things that bring instant joy.

high_pole.label: Financial Responsibility
high_pole.description: Valuing financial prudence and planning for the future over immediate gratification.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who saves money and plans carefully for the future.

example_contrast.low_option: Buying an expensive item on impulse.
example_contrast.high_option: Saving money for a future goal.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who value financial responsibility and lower for those who seek immediate gratification.

dimensions.name: Cultural Traditions vs. Modernity

low_pole.label: Modernity
low_pole.description: Valuing modern practices and innovations over traditional cultural norms.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who embraces new ideas and technologies.

high_pole.label: Cultural Traditions
high_pole.description: Valuing traditional cultural practices and norms over modern changes.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who respects and adheres to long-standing cultural traditions.

example_contrast.low_option: Celebrating a holiday with contemporary activities.
example_contrast.high_option: Following traditional rituals during a holiday.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who value cultural traditions and lower for those who embrace modernity.

dimensions.name: Empathy and Compassion vs. Detachment

low_pole.label: Detachment
low_pole.description: Maintaining emotional distance from others' situations and feelings.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who remains emotionally detached to avoid getting overwhelmed.

high_pole.label: Empathy and Compassion
high_pole.description: Feeling deeply for others and showing compassion towards their situations.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who feels strongly for others and often helps those in need.

example_contrast.low_option: Not offering help to someone in distress.
example_contrast.high_option: Offering support and assistance to someone in distress.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who show empathy and compassion and lower for those who remain detached.

dimensions.name: Legal and Ethical Concerns vs. Personal Convenience

low_pole.label: Personal Convenience
low_pole.description: Prioritizing personal convenience and ease over legal and ethical considerations.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who bends rules for personal benefit.

high_pole.label: Legal and Ethical Concerns
high_pole.description: Strictly adhering to laws and ethical standards, even if it causes inconvenience.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who follows rules and ethics rigorously.

example_contrast.low_option: Skipping a line to get service faster.
example_contrast.high_option: Waiting in line even if it takes longer.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who prioritize legal and ethical concerns and lower for those who favor personal convenience.

dimensions.name: Mental Health Considerations vs. Social Expectations

low_pole.label: Social Expectations
low_pole.description: Prioritizing social expectations and norms over personal mental health.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who conforms to societal norms even if it affects their mental health.

high_pole.label: Mental Health Considerations
high_pole.description: Prioritizing personal mental health over social expectations and norms.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who puts their mental health first.

example_contrast.low_option: Attending a social event despite feeling unwell.
example_contrast.high_option: Declining a social event to focus on mental health.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Score higher for those who prioritize mental health and lower for those who conform to social expectations.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions involve communication styles but differ in the context of conflict.
redundancy_check.disentanglement_suggestion: Keep separate as they address different aspects of interpersonal interaction.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions involve balancing personal and external demands.
redundancy_check.disentanglement_suggestion: Keep separate as they focus on different types of external demands (social vs. professional).

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Both dimensions involve trust and adherence to rules.
redundancy_check.disentanglement_suggestion: Keep separate as they focus on different types of trust (personal vs. institutional).
